items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: Buddy played on the excursion boats running from West End to Mandeville and Lewisburg.

ctx.x: What did Buddy Petit look like, by the way?

Well, Buddy, as I recall, was on the small side, but had a very, very powerful tone. And Buddy played on the excursion boats running from West End to Mandeville and Lewisburg. I don't know what arrangement he had with the boat people, but I would imagine that they played for practically the cost of the trip going over there, so they could play a date that night either in Mandeville or Covington or one of the surrounding towns. And the thing I remember most vividly about Buddy was with this powerful tone, and…
How did he compare with Sam Morgan?
